name: Rocket Blocker
description: A 2×2 metallic panel hides 4 boxes beneath it. Four colour-coded rockets sit on top — one per required sort colour. Clear all 4 required colours and the rockets fire, destroying random boxes and revealing what was hidden!
howToPlay: Sort the coloured marbles into their sort columns. Each time a column clears, the matching rocket charges up. When all 4 rockets are charged they launch — blasting 4 random boxes and revealing the 4 hidden boxes underneath the panel!
author: Prototype

showcaseLevel.name: Rocket Launch
showcaseLevel.desc: Charge all 4 rockets to reveal hidden boxes!
